groups.name: jfoundry.outbox.recovery
groups.description: Stuck DISPATCHING recovery for the JDK Outbox worker.

groups.name: jfoundry.outbox.cleanup
groups.description: Terminal-row cleanup for the JDK Outbox worker.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.table-name
properties.description: Physical MyBatis-Plus Outbox table name. Applications must create the table themselves.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.dispatcher.enabled
properties.description: Whether this process runs the JDK Outbox worker for dispatch, recovery, and cleanup. Set false for recorder-only processes.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.dispatcher.interval
properties.description: Fixed-delay interval between Outbox dispatch ticks.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.dispatcher.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum pending records claimed by one dispatch attempt.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.dispatcher.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum delivery attempts before a record is dead-lettered.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.recovery.stuck-timeout
properties.description: Age after which DISPATCHING records are rolled back to PENDING.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.cleanup.published-retention-days
properties.description: Retention in days for PUBLISHED records.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.cleanup.dead-lettered-retention-days
properties.description: Retention in days for DEAD_LETTERED records.

properties.name: jfoundry.outbox.cleanup.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum records deleted in one cleanup batch.
